ACTUAL PAGES

A closer look.

Selected pages from the complete files. Download the partial preview to explore the content.

Files & use.

What do I receive?

XLSX workbook + 9-page PDF guide. English, undated and licensed for personal use. No physical item is shipped. The complete paid files are not included in the public preview.

Which application do I need?

A spreadsheet application that supports XLSX formulas and charts. The included guide explains setup, the 1,000-row capacity and Google Sheets import. Calculations passed authoring-engine tests; native Excel and Google Sheets behavior has not been independently tested.

How do I get support?

Email metal_cook@hotmail.com with your product name and order reference. Never send passwords, payment-card details or private journal answers.

THOUGHTFULLY PUT TOGETHER

What is inside.

  • Five connected worksheets with a monthly overview and a native annual income-and-expense chart
  • A reusable monthly budget with 14 expense categories and planned-versus-actual totals
  • 1,000 dated transaction rows, category dropdowns and input-review messages
  • Ten savings goals with remaining amounts, progress and estimated contribution months
  • Twenty subscriptions with monthly cost estimates for weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual charges
  • Nine-page PDF guide; no macros, bank connections or automatic money movement
A SIMPLE WAY FORWARD
01

Record the month

Set one currency and a first-of-month date. Record actual income, expenses and transfers once.

02

Understand the difference

Compare your plan with actual categories and use the annual view to see recorded patterns.

03

Review and adjust

Review goals and subscriptions, reconcile your records and choose one next-month adjustment.
